card.name: Spots just before needle or injection words
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation right before the model expects needle, injection or vein, such as 'through a', 'into a' or a step number. It appears in injection instructions and in blood-draw descriptions.

modes.label: Article or preposition before needle
modes.description: The word 'a' or 'through' right before needle or vein in blood draws and injections.
modes.example: which is drawn through<< a>> needle from a vein in your arm.

modes.label: Step or figure numbers in injection steps
modes.description: A space or period after a step number or figure label in needle-handling instructions.
modes.example: Insert the needle until the bevel (slanted opening of the tip) is just under the skin (and no further) ( Figure<< >>5b ).

modes.label: Needle size decimals
modes.description: The decimal point in a needle or syringe size, just before the word needle.
modes.example: subcutaneously inject using a 27-gauge x 0<<.>>5” needle.

card.writes: It boosts needle and injection words as the next word and suppresses unrelated words.
card.plain: It marks places in the text where a needle or injection is about to be named.
